_comment: project-context per-project config. On first run, copied to <your-projects-root>/<project-slug>/project-context/config.json and the agent fills missing values from chat. This agent writes the shared context folder every other agent reads. Edit freely after that. web_enrichment: auto, off, firecrawl, jina, http or exa (auto = Firecrawl when FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is set and spend is confirmed with --confirm-spend after the founder agreed, else keyless Jina Reader, else plain HTTP; exa only when asked for, also with --confirm-spend). Optional: add a tools object (same keys as shared/tools.example.json) to pin providers for this agent only; the project-wide choices live in project-context/tools.json, which this agent offers to write. Every API is optional.
